explanation: Recursively carry inclusive lower and upper bounds. Check each node against the full ancestor-imposed range, then tighten the upper bound for the left subtree and lower bound for the right. Equal keys are allowed by this EPI contract.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion space for tree height h.
